description: Valkey (Redis-compatible) metrics collected by the OpenTelemetry Collector redis receiver.

panels.description: Time since the Valkey server started.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: Replication role reported by the server (`redis.role`).
panels.title: Role

panels.description: Client connections, excluding connections from replicas.
panels.title: Connected clients

panels.description: Instantaneous operations per second reported by the server.
panels.title: Operations per second

panels.description: Share of key lookups that found the key, over the latest rate interval. Shows "No lookups" when there were none.
panels.title: Keyspace hit ratio

panels.description: Memory allocated by Valkey's allocator. Max memory shows "Not set" when `maxmemory` is 0 (no limit).
panels.title: Memory used

panels.description: Rate of all commands processed by the server (`redis.commands.processed`).
panels.title: Commands processed per second

panels.description: Median latency per command (`redis.cmd.latency`, percentile p50).
panels.title: p50 latency by command

panels.description: 99th percentile latency per command (`redis.cmd.latency`, percentile p99).
panels.title: p99 latency by command

panels.description: Successful and failed key lookups per second.
panels.title: Keyspace hits and misses

panels.description: Number of keys, and keys with an expiration, per logical database.
panels.title: Keys by database

panels.description: Keys removed per second because their TTL expired or because of the eviction policy.
panels.title: Expired and evicted keys

panels.description: Memory used by Valkey. The max memory series only appears when `maxmemory` is set.
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: RSS divided by used memory. Values well above 1.5 point to fragmentation; values below 1 mean the OS swapped memory out.
panels.title: Memory fragmentation ratio

panels.description: Connected clients and clients blocked on a blocking call (BLPOP, BRPOP, ...).
panels.title: Clients

panels.description: New connections accepted, and connections rejected because of the `maxclients` limit.
panels.title: Connections per second

panels.description: Bytes read from and written to the network.
panels.title: Network traffic

panels.description: CPU time consumed per second. 100% equals one full core. user and sys cover all Valkey threads, *_children covers forked processes such as RDB saves. The main thread line is already part of user and sys, so it is drawn on its own and not stacked.
panels.title: CPU usage

list.description: Valkey server, from the `server.address` resource attribute.
list.label: Server
list.name: server

title: Valkey
